failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 explicitly names the missing entity: 'Information about "Tunisian Victory" (film) - its release date and production details'. Summary_2 repeats: 'The passages contain no information about the movie "Tunisian Victory"'. The hop 3 query explicitly targets it: 'Tunisian Victory film Ken Burns documentary Charles McDowell Jr journalist voice'. Despite this well-formed query targeting the named gap, hop 3 retrieval returns documents about Ken Burns films but no document about Tunisian Victory itself.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: The trace shows only two retrieval hops executed (hop 1 and hop 3 visible in RETRIEVAL EVENT messages; hop 2 documents are shown but without a hop 2 query being generated by the coordinator). Hop 3 query 'Tunisian Victory film Ken Burns documentary Charles McDowell Jr journalist voice' returns largely duplicate documents already seen in hop 1: Charles McDowell Jr. (journalist) article appears in both hop 1 and hop 3 results verbatim; The Congress (1988 film) appears in both; The West appears in both. The query did not advance retrieval beyond what was already obtained.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1 results, passages [3] Charles Wilkinson (director), [4] Moguls and Movie Stars, [5] Charles S. McDowell (different person from 1871-1943), and [7] Burning Heads are clearly irrelevant to the claim about Tunisian Victory and Ken Burns documentaries featuring journalist Charles McDowell Jr. Yet these were retrieved and presented to the solver, and in hop 3 several of these same irrelevant documents reappear (Charles Wilkinson, Moguls and Movie Stars, Charles S. McDowell, Burning Heads).
